verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verse_spoken: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning asking you to show me your purpose for my life.
You formed me with care, and nothing about my story is wasted in your hands.
When I feel lost or unsure of where I am going, remind me that you are leading me.
Help me see how even the hard seasons are working together for good.
Quiet the voices that tell me I am too late or not enough.
Open my eyes to the people you have placed in my path today.
Give me a willing heart to serve, to love, and to use the gifts you have given me.
Guide everyone praying with me who is searching for meaning and direction right now.
Thank you that my life is held in your plan, and your plan is good.
